newsitem.title: FRANCE: SGB has fewer Accor voting rights.
newsitem.headline: SGB has fewer Accor voting rights.

text.p: Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB) confirmed its voting rights in French hotels group Accor fell below the 10 and five percent levels on February 20, following off-market sales of Accor stock, the SBF French stock markets association said on Thursday.

SGB now holds 100,000 shares and voting rights representing 0.30 percent of the capital and 0.26 percent of the total voting rights. It also holds securities with rights to 211,616 Accor shares and voting rights.
SGB said on February 19 it was selling Accor stock for a capital gain of over two billion Belgian francs.
